en: Once upon a time, there was a happy spirit who loved to dance. She danced all day and all night. She was so good at dancing that everyone who saw her became envious. One day, a little girl named Lucy saw the spirit dancing. Lucy said, "Wow! I want to dance like you!" The spirit smiled and said, "You can dance with me, Lucy!" So, Lucy and the spirit danced together every day. They had so much fun and became best friends. And everyone who saw them dancing together felt happy too.
tp: tenpo pini la kon pona li lon. ona li olin tawa musi. ona li tawa musi lon tenpo suno ale lon tenpo pimeja ale. ona li tawa musi pona mute la jan ale li lukin e ona li wile jo e pona ona. tenpo suno wan la meli lili Lusi li lukin e ni: kon li tawa musi. meli Lusi li toki e ni: a! mi wile tawa musi sama sina! kon li pilin pona li toki e ni: meli Lusi o, sina ken tawa musi lon poka mi! ni la meli Lusi en kon li tawa musi lon tenpo suno ale. ona tu li pilin musi mute li kama jan pona nanpa wan. jan ale li lukin e ni: ona tu li tawa musi lon tenpo sama. jan ale ni li pilin pona kin.

en: Once upon a time, there was a nice seal. The seal lived in the sea. The seal liked to play and feel the water on its skin. The seal had many friends in the sea. One day, the seal met a big fish. The big fish wanted to play with the seal. They played together and had lots of fun. The seal felt happy to have a new friend. But the big fish was not a nice friend. One day, the big fish ate the seal. The seal was gone. The sea was sad without the nice seal.
tp: tenpo pini la soweli telo pona li lon. ona li lon telo suli. ona li olin musi li olin pilin e telo lon selo ona. soweli telo li jo e jan pona mute lon telo suli. tenpo suno wan la soweli telo li kama lukin e kala suli. kala suli li wile musi lon poka pi soweli telo. ona tu li musi lon tenpo sama li pilin musi mute. soweli telo li pilin pona tan jan pona sin. taso kala suli li jan pona pona ala. tenpo suno wan la kala suli li moku e soweli telo. soweli telo li weka. telo suli li pilin ike tan ni: soweli telo pona li lon ala.
